newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton ranged on low buys, limited offerings.
newsitem.headline: India cotton ranged on low buys, limited offerings.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady in a narrow range on the local market as mill buying remained slow but limited supplies kept offerings restricted on Monday, dealers said.
"Widespread rain in the various producing centres has disrupted transportation," one broker said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi was quiet at 1,000/1,075 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), as was Punjab saw-ginned at 1,820/1,855 rupees per maund.
In the Gujarat segment, Kalyan cotton was steady at 14,200/14,700 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) as was Wagad cotton at 13,000/13,200 rupees and Kala-ginned at 12,300/12,400 rupees per candy.
Sentiment remained subdued at the close amid limited physical enquiries coupled with reports of commencement of new crop arrivals in south India, particularly in Karnataka.
"Scattered new crop arrivals have already commenced in the Karnataka region and will pick up in the coming days," a broker added.
